elements.name: Sessions empty and ready states
copy: The daemon is answering and two repositories are visible to it. A session is a worktree plus a thread, so starting one never touches your checkout.

elements.name: Failed session read state
copy: The daemon accepted the connection and then stopped answering mid-read. Domovoi will not show a partial thread, because a partial thread reads like a finished one.
nothing was written, nothing was lost
The session is still on the machine. A client that cannot read it has not changed it.
If a turn was running it is still running. The daemon does not need this window.
Any gate raised while you were away is still waiting, and will be here when the read succeeds.
evidence: The session is still on the machine. A client that cannot read it has not changed it.
If a turn was running it is still running. The daemon does not need this window.
notes: 2026-10-14 (S3): built for the read a session open makes. session.activate answers with the workspace that holds the session's thread; when it ends without an answer (no answer within the request budget, the connection closed, an answer the client cannot parse), the desktop and web thread column draws FailedSessionRead for the session asked for, in place of the previous session's thread. The header count is the reads this client sent for that session in a row, and WHAT IT TRIED logs the last five. Try again sends session.activate again and Open the machine opens the Machines view; both work in phone and tablet tabs. A daemon refusal stays in the shell's alert. The connect read before any snapshot stays with ThreadSkeleton (Q344 A), and the provider-restart caller is unchanged.

partial.reason: The phone draws Nothing has run yet and its body on an empty session, with no Worktree ready header. Since 2026-10-02 desktop and web draw the Worktree ready header, the title, body, What it will do first and the Say what you want done in <project> placeholder on a fresh session, and the start line (repo, branch, worktree, started HH:MM) otherwise (ruling Q368 A: rows from the session's mode and checkpoint policy). Still open: the starters, deferred by Q368 until a suggestion source exists; the header's off <branch>, since a session does not carry the branch its worktree was cut from; and the tablet, which draws no start state.

humanRead.note: Q385 A: Clone a repository is cut from the empty sessions state on every client, as the phone's clone was cut on 2026-09-18; there is no clone RPC. The copy stays claimed here because the design still draws it.

Q368 A: the OR START FROM SOMETHING IT ALREADY KNOWS starters are deferred until a suggestion source exists, and the What it will do first rows follow the session's permission mode and checkpoint policy rather than the drawn Ask-like lines.

Q344 A: once the first attempt fails the skeleton stops and says Not connected. Nothing has been read from <host> yet., a third state the design does not draw; the drawn shimmer would claim a read that is not happening.

S3, recommendation applied under the standing ruling of 2026-10-06: the session read draws two of the design's three What is still true lines. Any gate raised while you were away is still waiting is left out because another client can answer a gate while this one cannot read. nothing was written, nothing was lost is not drawn for it either: opening a session writes the daemon's active session. The message names how the read ended (no answer, connection closed, unreadable answer), with the design's sentence for no answer. The app bar title still names the session that was open before; the failed state names the one asked for in WHAT IT TRIED.

strings: The daemon answers and the list is empty. Empty is a state with a cause, so the screen names the cause.
Skeletons in the shape of what is coming, and a line saying which machine is being read.
A partial thread reads like a finished one, so Domovoi refuses to show one.
Two of three machines answered, so the count reads 2 of 3. No results and not searched are different answers.
The worktree is cut and no turn has been taken. The first message is what starts it.
Clear the search to see all three.
Sessions you start on this machine will appear here, newest first.
Migrate billing webhooks to the new idempotency table
Read the repository. It cannot write until a gate or a rule permits it.
Write a plan you can read, edit and reject before any step runs.
Take a checkpoint before the first approved write, so every step is revertible.
Continue the search index backfill from its last checkpoint
Review the open pull requests by risk
Explain what changed in acme-api this week
